hook.name: FlutchV4Hook
hook.description: Manages token paired launches on Uniswap v4, charging a 1% fee on every swap taken in afterSwap via the fee-taking delta pattern. Fees in the paired asset are split among the protocol (30%), creator, and a buyback bucket; fees in the launch token are held and converted separately by a keeper. All liquidity is owned by the hook and locked permanently.
